objective: P2 Stage 1 (risk policy): cap the semiconductor theme share of each ETF sleeve's ex-ante variance at four levels by substitution (CAP) or a theme-neutral hedge (H1 margin, H2 cash), measure on the ETF pilot (S3 0.642 + C2 0.358) the same-volatility recent Sharpe cost and the stress and theme-shock benefit, and select the tightest level within a 0.10 Sharpe cost as the pilot concentration limit.

sources.core_claim: Roncalli and Weisang, Risk Parity Portfolios with Risk Factors (MPRA 44017): Euler decomposition holds in factor coordinates; Theorem 2: when the risk measure is volatility the risk contribution of factor j is RC(F_j) = (A'x)_j (A+ Sigma x)_j / sigma(x); risk budgets set on assets can leave factor risk contributions unbalanced.
sources.project_applicability: Defines the theme risk share TRS as the Euler contribution of the orthogonalised SMH factor to sleeve variance, the quantity the cap limits.
sources.reflection: Theory and illustrations; no evidence on semiconductors or on the Sharpe cost of a cap. Snapshot reports/research/intel/sources/p2-s1-theme-budget-2026-10-05/roncalli-weisang-2012-risk-parity-risk-factors-mpra44017.txt.

sources.core_claim: MSCI Barra USE4 explains US equity returns with industry factors, style factors and specific risk; industry exposures are managed as factor risk in the same covariance.
sources.project_applicability: Professional practice: an industry or theme is a risk unit with its own factor; supports budgeting the semiconductor theme as a factor rather than predicting the cycle.
sources.reflection: Methodology note, no performance claim. Snapshot reports/research/intel/sources/regime-cycle-2026-10-04/msci-use4-methodology.txt (fetched 2026-10-04 18:43 UTC).

sources.core_claim: Tzikas, Candes, Hastie, Boyd, Kochenderfer, Kahn (Stanford and BlackRock): commercial risk models are of high quality but may fail to capture changing regimes and transient factors; adding transient statistical factors captures structure the original model misses.
sources.project_applicability: A fixed industry model can under-measure a fast-rising theme such as AI semiconductors; justifies a dedicated rolling theme factor with a 126-session window.
sources.reflection: Preprint; the authors' factors are statistical, ours is a named ETF factor. Snapshot reports/research/intel/sources/regime-cycle-2026-10-04/arxiv__transient-statistical-factors-risk-model-2605.12977.txt.

sources.core_claim: MSCI stress-tests thematic indexes with its crowding model and scenarios; crowding helped explain the efficient-energy theme's underperformance from March 2021.
sources.project_applicability: Practice of managing a theme with exposure limits and stress replays; motivates the three SMH shock replays as the benefit measure.

sources.core_claim: Alpaca: 50% initial margin (Reg T); overnight maintenance 30% long above $6, 50% long 2x leveraged ETF, 75% long 3x leveraged ETF, short at or above $5 the greater of $5/share or 30%; $0 locate and borrow fees on easy-to-borrow shares; margin interest 6.50% a year for non-elite users.
sources.project_applicability: Sets the H1 feasibility rules, the 0 bp borrow main case and the 6.5% debit and re-levering cost.
sources.reflection: Fetched 2026-10-04 (docs host unreachable from this box on 10-05); rates can change. Snapshot reports/research/intel/sources/mid-frequency-2026-10-04/alpaca-margin-short-docs.txt.

sources.core_claim: Hsieh et al., Compounding Effects in Leveraged ETFs: LETF performance depends on return autocorrelation and dynamics, not only volatility drag; trending markets help and mean reversion hurts.
sources.project_applicability: The cash-account hedge uses SOXS, a -3x daily-reset fund; its decay is path-dependent, so the backtest must use actual SOXS returns, not -3 x SMH.

sources.core_claim: The PHLX Semiconductor Index lost about 21% in July 2026, its worst month since October 2008, while the S&P 500 total return slipped 0.1%; the move is attributed to crowding and leverage, with long global semiconductors named the most crowded trade by 73-82% of BofA survey respondents in May-July.
sources.project_applicability: Defines the R3 replay and shows that theme risk materialised without a fundamental turn, so a forecast-free exposure limit is the relevant control.
sources.reflection: Practitioner commentary; survey figures second-hand (BofA original not read). Snapshot reports/research/intel/sources/regime-cycle-2026-10-04/atranica-what-happened-to-semis-in-july.txt.

sources.core_claim: H-20260923-09: the live S3 is a vol-targeted levered semiconductor position; SOXL + USD average 58.5% of weight in the anchor window and 69.4% in the holdout; leaving SOXL out drops the holdout Sharpe from 2.28 to 0.96.
sources.project_applicability: Sets the prior: a semiconductor cap is likely to cost recent Sharpe; the contract must define what happens when no level is within the cost tolerance.
